Inspection routine: suit and gloves, light the smoker, two puffs at the entrance, wait a minute. Lift the roof, check the feed jar, then pull frames one by one: look for eggs, capped brood, stores, and queen cells. Note temperament. Close up gently and record findings in [[hive-inspection-archive]]. Fuel rules in [[smoker-fuel-only-natural]].
